patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: Avocado. The avocado won. I looked away for one second, and now there is more of me on the cutting board than I am comfortable with. It's not squirting, I checked. I can still bend everything.
clinical.presentationShort: 45yo M — palmar laceration from a knife, bleeding controlled, full flexion & sensation.
clinical.presentationLong: 45-year-old male, palm laceration from a kitchen knife, bleeding controlled, full finger flexion and sensation intact.

diagnosis.primary: Palmar laceration ('avocado hand'), no tendon/nerve/vascular injury
diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → irrigate, confirm tendon/nerve/vascular intact, suture, tetanus update
diagnosis.why: 'Avocado hand' is a real named injury. Not squirting + full finger motion = a one-resource ESI 4. Always still test distal tendon and nerve first.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, holding his hand wrapped in a blood-spotted kitchen towel
signs: hand wrapped in a lightly bloodstained towel
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 45-year-old man in a weekend cooking apron, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting, holding one hand wrapped in a blood-spotted kitchen towel. Expression: sheepish half-smile, embarrassed. Clearly visible: hand wrapped in a lightly bloodstained towel, calm and composed. Overall minor and stable. No text, no logos.
